description: Returns the paid x402 request for your order of DAO treasury report, monthly (POST /buy/dao-report, $99 in one payment; schema linked); this call places and charges nothing, and an order exists only if your own client pays that request. POST that JSON body to the URL with an x402 or MPP client; the order id and status link come back with the receipt. Bad input is refused before any charge. Free check first: POST the same body plus your email to /buy/dao-report/check (email required there). Monthly plan: one report from public on-chain data within 24 hours of payment, no automatic billing; for a year use buy_dao_report_yearly.

address.description: optional treasury address if you have no Snapshot space

email.description: optional: where to send the files too; without it they are on the order status page

space.description: your Snapshot space id, e.g. yourdao.eth

name: buy_dao_report
title: Buy DAO report
